name: How do I choose a qualified general contractor for a second-story addition?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose a qualified general contractor for a second-story addition?

acceptedAnswer.text: To choose a qualified general contractor, look for one with specific experience in second-story additions and a strong portfolio of completed projects. Verify their license, insurance, and bonding to ensure they meet legal requirements and protect you from liability. Check references from previous clients and read online reviews. Request detailed bids that clearly outline all costs and project timelines. A good contractor will communicate effectively, demonstrate expertise in structural modifications, and be familiar with local building codes in areas like Huntington Beach or Irvine.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor experienced in second-story additions, with verified licenses, insurance, and bonding. Check references, review portfolios, and request detailed bids. They should be familiar with local building codes and communicate clearly.
